===== HEAD (office) README =====
    55	
    56	All gameplay code lives under `src/`:
    57	
    58	| Folder | Contents |
    59	| --- | --- |
    60	| `app` | top-level game state wiring |
    61	| `ai` | bot planners, bot profiles, matchmaking and skill rating |
    62	| `assets` | asset and audio managers with graceful fallbacks |
    63	| `camera` | camera controller, modes, smoothing and collision avoidance |
    64	| `config` | tunable game configuration values |
    65	| `contracts` | shared types for events, math, services and zones |
    66	| `core` | renderer, scene manager and save manager |
    67	| `courses` | course builder, hole model and the course data sets |
    68	| `dev` | launch options, diagnostics overlay and presentation minimap |
    69	| `effects` | particle effects |
    70	| `gameplay` | match flow, turns, scoring, rating, state machine and zones |
    71	| `input` | keyboard, mouse and touch-ready input handling |
    72	| `leaderboard` | leaderboard model, generator and styles |
    73	| `obstacles` | rotating parts, conveyors, fans, pads, teleporters |
    74	| `physics` | physics world, ball physics, shot system and collision layers |
    75	| `player` | player profile, progression and types |
    76	| `ui` | HUD, overlays, scoreboard and DOM helpers |
    77	
    78	## Debug mode
    79	
    80	Debug features are enabled through URL flags (see `src/dev/LaunchOptions.ts`):
    81	
    82	| Flag | Effect |
    83	| --- | --- |
    84	| `?debug=1` | enable debug mode and the developer overlay |
    85	| `?course=<id>` | start directly on the given course |
    86	| `?hole=<n>` | start directly on the given hole number |
    87	
    88	Available course ids: `green-hills`, `pirate-bay`, `candy-factory`, `ancient-temple`, `arctic-base`, `volcano`, `neon-city`, `haunted-mansion`, `space-station`, `chaos-dimension`.
    89	
    90	Example: `http://localhost:5173/?debug=1&course=volcano&hole=4`
    91	
    92	Hotkeys available while debug mode is active:
    93	
    94	| Key | Effect |
    95	| --- | --- |
    96	| `F1` | toggle the diagnostics overlay |
    97	| `F2` | toggle wireframe rendering |
    98	| `F3` | toggle the minimap |
    99	
   100	## Audio assets
   101	
   102	`public/audio` holds the placeholder structure for sound. No audio binaries are committed to the repository: `public/audio/manifest.json` lists every audio event the game can play, using the definition shape consumed by `src/assets/AudioManager.ts` (`id`, `url`, `category`, `volume`, `loop`, `optional`). Every entry is marked `optional`, so the AudioManager treats a missing file as a non-fatal fallback and the game simply runs silently.
   103	
   104	To enable sound, drop `.mp3` files into `public/audio/<category>/<id>.mp3` matching the manifest entries. See `public/audio/README.md` for the folder layout and naming rules.
